## About this round

NiYA x Cascador Founders Programme Pitch Day (Abuja), announced 10 Nov 2026 by FMYD/NiYA and Cascador: NGN 5 million non-dilutive funding to this founder's business (TechBuild lists SewPro as winner, founder Andrew Ogbeh). TechBuild.Africa describes the award as non-dilutive funding; Vanguard (23 Aug 2026 programme report) describes the programme as grants with Cascador as funder/donor. Amount disclosed in NGN only; no USD amount sourced. Date basis: TechBuild article publication 2026-11-10 ('announced today').
